description: MARCXML (slim) to MODS 3.7, implemented from the Library of Congress MARC to MODS mapping specification.
MODS 3.x back to MARCXML (slim) with a synthesized leader and 008, covering the core of the forward crosswalk.
MARCXML (slim) to simple Dublin Core in the OAI-PMH oai_dc container; collections get a neutral dcRecords wrapper.
Simple Dublin Core (oai_dc, OAI-PMH responses, dcRecords) to minimally valid MARCXML with leader and 008 constructed.
MARCXML (slim) to qualified Dublin Core in the DCMI Metadata Terms namespace, as plain qdcRecord elements without RDF.
MARCXML (slim) to RDF/XML built on DCMI Metadata Terms; one rdf:Description per record, first 856$u becomes rdf:about.
MARCXML (slim) to a collection-level EAD3 finding-aid skeleton: control, archdesc did, scopecontent and controlaccess.
A human-readable rendering of MARCXML: one card per record, 245 as heading, leader and fields as a tag/indicator/subfield table.
MARCXML (slim) to schema.org JSON-LD, one object per record as NDJSON, mirroring the marc_jsonld SQL macro key for key.
MARCXML (slim) to RIS citation records: reference type from leader/06-07, tagged lines, ER terminator per record.
MARC 21 Bibliographic to UNIMARC Bibliographic at field level, written from the IFLA UNIMARC Manual; slim XML container both sides.
MARC 21 to UNIMARC-shaped MARCXML, a documented subset: record label, 001, 100, 101, 200, 210, 215, 606, 700/701.
UNIMARC Bibliographic to MARC 21 Bibliographic at field level, the inverse of the IFLA-based forward crosswalk.
RUSMARC Bibliographic to MARC 21, a delta over the UNIMARC crosswalk: 686 BBK to 084 with $2 rubbk, 802 to 022 $2, the 801 source conventions, the coded 100 $a positions and the 9XX national block.
MARC 21 Bibliographic to RUSMARC, the inverse delta: 084 $2 rubbk to 686, 022 $2 to 802, 801 with the Russian country, agency, date and cataloguing-rules subfields, 9XX carried through.
KORMARC (KS X 6006) to MARC 21: 056 KDC to 084 $2 kdc, 049 holdings and the 090/052 call numbers to 852, 940 to 246, 950 to 037 $c; shared fields copied in tag order.
MARC 21 to KORMARC (KS X 6006), the inverse: 084 $2 kdc to 056, 852 to 049 and 090, 037 $c to 950; everything else copied in tag order.

INTERMARC (BnF) to MARC 21, an honest subset: headings with the numeric function codes as relator codes, 145 to 240, 245 and 260 by shape-tolerant rules, 280 to 300, the 3XX notes, and the RAMEAU 6XX block.
MARC 21 to INTERMARC (BnF), the inverse of the same subset; no coded data is generated.
JAPAN/MARC MARC21 reading and parallel-script conventions expressed as standard 880 and $6 linkage: pairs, occurrence numbers, script identification codes and indicators repaired; content untouched.
IBERMARC (Spain, retired) to MARC 21: 017 to 016, the 59X local block kept, leader lengths zeroed and UTF-8 declared, everything else copied in tag order.
MAB2 (Germany and Austria, retired) to MARC 21: the bibliographic core from the published field directory; expects slim-shaped input and does not interpret the MAB2 record label.
MARCXML (slim) to ONIX for Books 3.x Product records with reference tag names; an honest subset of a full trade Product message.
MARCXML (slim) to Europeana Data Model RDF/XML: edm:ProvidedCHO, ore:Aggregation and edm:WebResource per record.
MARC 21 Authority records to MADS 2.x: 1XX authority, 4XX variants, 5XX related, 667/670 notes, 010/001 identifiers.
MARCXML (slim) to BIBFRAME 2.x RDF/XML: sibling bf:Work, bf:Instance and bf:Item resources with the documented subset of properties.
BIBFRAME 2.x RDF/XML back to MARCXML (slim); inverts exactly the resource shapes the forward crosswalk emits.
